first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The man with a crew cut on the image-left, with a slim, lanky build, wearing a dark zip-up jacket and dark trousers.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The man slightly to the image-right wearing a dark knit cap, a loose dark leather jacket, a light-colored turtleneck top, and light-colored trousers.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The man entering from the image-right, wearing a dark knit cap with a pom-pom-like protrusion on top, a heavy dark coat, and camouflage trousers, with a large light-colored hood or collar around the neck and shoulders.

entities.name: multistory buildings along the street
entities.identification: Continuous multistory building masses on both sides of the road and a spire in the distant center, with rows of windows and horizontal balcony lines discernible in the background.

entities.name: city road
entities.identification: The road behind and below the people, converging toward the distant center between the buildings on both sides.

entities.name: trees along the street
entities.identification: Clusters of tree canopies forming irregular dark gray masses on both sides of the road.

entities.name: overcast sky
entities.identification: The light gray sky in the gaps between the buildings, with soft bands of varying light and dark tones in the upper center.

entities.name: cars on the road
entities.identification: The group of background vehicles arranged in depth along the central road, appearing mainly as blurred low vehicle bodies and bright lights.

entities.name: dark metal railing
entities.identification: The dark horizontal top rail extending behind the people, with spaced vertical posts and widened joints at the bottom.

entities.name: stone parapet
entities.identification: The horizontal parapet below the railing, with a wide dark coping on top and a mottled light gray wall surface below.

entities.name: streetlights along the street
entities.identification: The streetlights in the background with slender dark poles and wide, horizontally oriented lamp heads at the top.
